reason: The existing mapping to Article 14 only covers the requirement to have crisis communication plans. The control objective also requires including these plans in ICT business continuity testing. Article 11(6)(b) explicitly mandates testing the crisis communication plans established under Article 14, which is a material part of the control objective not covered by the existing mapping.

missing_mappings.reason: This provision explicitly requires the testing of crisis communication plans, which is a material part of the control objective that is not covered by the existing mapping to Article 14.

applicability_note: The control requires both the existence of communication plans (Article 14) and their inclusion in testing (Article 11(6)(b)). The existing mapping only addresses the former.
challenge_comment: The assessment item specifies that the control includes communication plans in testing, but the existing mapping only covers the plan creation, not the testing requirement.
